_census: THE FIELD CENSUS IS THE ROUND-TRIP ASSERTION. Each entry names a key in the .oolite-save plist, the JS expression that reads the same quantity back out of the loaded game, and how the two are made comparable. A field is in this census because it was MEASURED to round-trip, not because it looked like it should - see tests/golden/save_load.py:probe_census and the README beside the staged golden. Adding a field here strengthens the gate; removing one weakens it, and test_save_load.py pins the census size so a silent removal fails.

census.why: PlayerEntity.m stores credits in tenths of a credit; the plist holds the raw integer-valued double, JS reports credits. Scale measured, not assumed.

the numeric legal status. player.bounty is the INTEGER accessor (OOJSPlayer.m:286-288 returns [player legalStatus] as an int); player.legalStatus returns a DISPLAY STRING via OODisplayStringFromLegalStatus (:226-228) and reads 'Clean' here - measured, and the reason this field names bounty.
the system the save pins; a save loaded into the wrong system is the single most damaging silent round-trip failure
galaxy index; a chart-level property distinct from the system
the shipdata key the player's hull is rebuilt from
human-facing class name, separate storage from ship_desc
kill score; a counter, so a round-trip that resets counters fails here
cargo capacity, an integer the loader recomputes rather than copies
pylon count, reconstructed from missile_roles by the loader
the plist stores fuel in tenths of a light year (70 = 7.0 LY); JS reports light years. Scale measured.
